title: Trump announces 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
summary: US President Donald Trump says both sides have agreed to stop targeting oil refineries, power plants and other energy infrastructure immediately.

image.caption: Ukraine's attacks within Russian territory have grown bolder in recent monthsImage: REUTERS

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure.
"Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine," the president wrote on his Truth Social network.
Trump continued: "Both parties have agreed," before urging restraint from both Kyiv and Moscow: "Do not break it!"
There was ‌no immediate ​confirmation ⁠from Moscow, but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told the news site Axios that the ceasefire was "news for me."
Earlier Sunday, Zelenskyy said his military would stop hitting Russian oil refineries if the Kremlin curbed its attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
Russia has repeatedly struck Ukraine's power plants and transmission lines around Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa and elsewhere, to lower civilian morale, especially during the winter months.
Recently, Ukraine has stepped up long-range strikes deep inside Russian territory, targeting major oil refineries and other facilities to curb Moscow's refining capacity and fuel supplies.
This is a developing story and will be updated as more information becomes available.
